```yaml
name: Build Debian Packages

on:
  # Build on releases
  release:
    types: [published]
  # Allow manual trigger
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      build_type:
        description: 'Build type (all, basic, hardsubx)'
        required: false
        default: 'all'
  # Build on pushes to workflow file for testing
  push:
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/build_deb.yml'
      - 'package_creators/debian.sh'
      - 'tools/update_gpac.py'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-deb:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        build_type: [basic, hardsubx]

    steps:
      - name: Check if should build this variant
        id: should_build
        run: |
          if [ "${{ github.event_name }}" = "workflow_dispatch" ]; then
            INPUT_TYPE="${{ github.event.inputs.build_type }}"
            if [ "$INPUT_TYPE" = "all" ] || [ "$INPUT_TYPE" = "${{ matrix.build_type }}" ]; then
              echo "should_build=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            else
              echo "should_build=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            fi
          else
            echo "should_build=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Checkout repository
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Free disk space
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        uses: jlumbroso/free-disk-space@main
        with:
          android: true
          dotnet: true
          haskell: true
          large-packages: true
          docker-images: true
          preinstalled-runtimes: true
          tool-cache: true
          swap-storage: true

      - name: Install base dependencies
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
            build-essential \
            devscripts \
            debhelper \
            dh-make \
            dh-exec \
            pkg-config \
            wget \
            file \
            zlib1g-dev \
            libpng-dev \
            libfreetype-dev \
            libutf8proc-dev \
            libtesseract-dev \
            libleptonica-dev \
            tesseract-ocr-eng \
            clang \
            libclang-dev \
            libgpac-dev \
            libavcodec-dev \
            libavformat-dev \
            libavutil-dev \
            libswscale-dev \
            libswresample-dev \
            libavfilter-dev \
            libavdevice-dev \
            libxcb1-dev \
            libxcb-shm0-dev

      - name: Install GPAC from source
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        run: |
          cd /tmp
          wget https://github.com/gpac/gpac/archive/refs/tags/abi-16.4.tar.gz
          tar -xzf abi-16.4.tar.gz
          cd gpac-abi-16.4
          ./configure --disable-static --enable-shared --prefix=/usr
          make -j$(nproc)
          sudo make install
          sudo ldconfig

      - name: Build Debian package
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        run: |
          chmod +x package_creators/debian.sh
          ./package_creators/debian.sh "${{ matrix.build_type }}"

      - name: Upload artifacts
        if: steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: ccextractor-${{ matrix.build_type }}.deb
          path: ccextractor_*.deb

      - name: Attach packages to release
        if: github.event_name == 'release' && steps.should_build.outputs.should_build == 'true'
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          script: |
            const fs = require('fs');
            const path = require('path');
            const { repo, owner } = context.repo;
            const releaseId = context.payload.release.id;
            const buildType = "${{ matrix.build_type }}";
            const packageName = `ccextractor_${buildType}.deb`;
            const packagePath = path.join(process.cwd(), packageName);
            
            if (fs.existsSync(packagePath)) {
              await github.rest.repos.uploadReleaseAsset({
                owner,
                repo,
                release_id: releaseId,
                asset_path: packagePath,
                name: packageName,
                label: packageName
              });
            }
```
